description: REVERIE is a student-led space technology and innovation team dedicated to exploring the mysteries of the universe. We aim to combine space science, artificial intelligence, robotics, coding, and creative problem-solving to develop innovative solutions for real-world challenges. Our vision is to turn imagination into scientific discovery and contribute to the future of space exploration.
summary: REVERIE is an intelligent research prototype designed to evaluate environmental and operational risks associated with future lunar missions. It analyzes planetary data, identifies relevant Earth-based analog environments, and helps researchers plan experiments to study terrain, temperature, lighting, dust-related conditions, and other mission challenges. Its goal is to improve the scientific preparation of future lunar exploration through evidence-based analysis.
details: WHAT EXACTLY DOES IT DO & HOW DOES IT WORK? REVERIE provides an integrated lunar mission research platform with four main capabilities: 1. Lunar Environment Analysis: Organizes scientific information about selected lunar regions. 2. Earth Analog Site Evaluator: Compares potential Earth environments using measurable terrain and environmental characteristics. 3. Mission Hazard Intelligence: Identifies relevant environmental challenges such as terrain difficulty, temperature differences, lighting limitations, and data gaps. 4. Experiment Recommendation Engine: Suggests research activities that can be conducted in an Earth analog environment based on available evidence. CORE FEATURES: - Planetary Environment Analyzer: Analyzes selected lunar and Martian environmental characteristics using available scientific datasets. - Earth Analog Site Evaluator: Evaluates potential Earth environments for specific planetary research and equipment-testing purposes. - Mission Hazard Intelligence: Identifies relevant environmental challenges such as terrain difficulty, temperature differences, lighting limitations, and data gaps. - Analog Difference Detector: Explains which planetary conditions are represented by an Earth analog and which conditions remain significantly different. - Experiment Recommendation Engine: Suggests research activities that can be conducted in an Earth analog environment based on available evidence. - Scientific Confidence Report: Displays data sources, measurement availability, uncertainties, and limitations to help users interpret results responsibly.
